description:
Refresh one named member segment of an audience against the current IAG, then refresh the audience's own version/expiry. An audience is a composition of one or more member segments, possibly of different subtypes — there is no "primary" segment, so segment_id is required (400 SEGMENT_ID_REQUIRED if omitted, 400 SEGMENT_NOT_A_MEMBER if it is not part of this audience). Behaviour is specific to the chosen segment's subtype:
- filter: synchronous — returns status: active immediately. record_count is null; call recount_audience if a fresh count is needed before quoting.
- matched: with hitl false/unset (default): returns status: pending + upload_url. Instruct the user to upload their identity list to upload_url (same or updated file). After upload, call wait_for_segment(segment_id) to block until identity resolution completes. With hitl: true: the upload is staged instead — follow the analyze_audience_upload -> confirm_column_mappings / cancel_matched_upload -> wait_for_segment sequence documented on create_segment(subtype=matched) (confirm_column_mappings/cancel_matched_upload take this segment_id, not audience_id).
- custom: immutable snapshot; returns 409 CUSTOM_REGENERATION_REQUIRED. Request a new internal data-team publication.
Always call get_audience first to see the member segments and their subtypes, so you can pick (or have the user pick) the right segment_id. Async build completion or failure may notify configured external webhooks and opted-in users by email. Requires 'creator' scope.

hitl.description: If true: stages a matched segment's re-upload instead of resolving automatically. Defaults to false.

segment_id.description: Which member segment of this audience to refresh. Required — there is no default/primary segment.

shard_count.description: Matched subtype: number of same-format shards. Every CSV shard must include its own header row.

name: refresh_audience

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions
